discovered_infrastructure_issue.symptom: The prior 20-candidate probe reported `0 valid / 20 invalid`. 18 of the 20 failures were identical `index.lock: File exists` checkout failures, and the probe later deadlocked.
discovered_infrastructure_issue.root_cause: NOT a cache/blob problem (blobs verified local and complete). The real cause is checkout wall-clock: a full ~6,661-file Django checkout on this host takes ~690s because Windows Defender realtime scanning is active in the write path (~9.6 files/s observed). The validator's checkout budget was 600s, i.e. BELOW the real cost, so healthy checkouts were killed mid-write and reported as `checkout_failed`; the killed process then left a live-looking index.lock that poisoned every subsequent candidate.
evidence: 403s timed checkout: 3890/6661 files written, process healthy and still progressing
8s and 25s CPU samples of the 'hung' git: 0 CPU delta, i.e. blocked in I/O, not deadlocked on logic
discovered_infrastructure_issue.fix: Checkout budget raised 600 -> 3600s (CHECKOUT_TIMEOUT), applied to `git worktree add` and `git checkout --detach`; a checkout timeout is now classified TIMEOUT, so it can never become CANDIDATE_INVALID.
